# Sariputra Tour & Holidays

> Premium travel marketplace and pilgrimage tour provider based in Bodh Gaya, Bihar, offering specialized vehicle rentals and customized all-India travel packages.

## Business Profile
* **Company Name:** Sariputra Tour & Holidays
* **Location:** Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India
* **Primary Contacts:** 
  * Phone: +91 99399 95360 / +91 90656 71630
  * Email: sariputratours@gmail.com
* **Service Region:** Bodh Gaya, Bihar Circuit (Rajgir, Nalanda, Patna, Gaya), and Pan-India Travel

## Offerings & Fleet Portfolio
* **Tour Packages:** Buddhist Pilgrimage Circuit tours, heritage itineraries, hill station trips, and custom group travel.
* **Vehicle Fleet:**
  * 7-Seater SUV/Family Vehicle
  * 17-Seater Force Urbania (Luxury Travel)
  * 17-Seater Tempo Traveller
  * 35-Seater Mini Bus
  * 45-Seater Tourist Coach
  * 49-Seater Premium Bus

## Technical Architecture & Developer Guidelines

### 1. AI Assistant System
* Current frontend features an in-browser demo travel assistant.
* **Production Directive:** For live deployment, route AI queries to a secure backend endpoint (`/api/chat`) to protect provider credentials.

### 2. Payment Gateway Configuration
* Configure real checkout URLs within `frontend/app.js` under `PAYMENT_LINK`.
* **Security Directive:** Never publish private payment secret keys or API credentials in client-side HTML/JS code. Order creation and signature verification must occur on the backend server.

### 3. Media & Assets Management
* Default images are structured under `assets/photos/`.
* Replace stock photos with high-resolution original fleet and destination photos while preserving existing filenames (`hero.jpg`, `vehicle-7.jpg`, `urbania.jpg`, `tempo.jpg`, `bus-35.jpg`, `bus-45.jpg`, `bus-49.jpg`).

### 4. Hosting & Deployment
* Frontend files (`index.html`, `style.css`, `app.js`) are static and optimized for hosting on GitHub Pages.
* Backend services (Python Flask / Java Spring Boot) must be deployed to dedicated cloud server instances.
